name: meal-balance-board
description: See food groups across your planned day.

interface.longDescription: See food groups across your planned day. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Map meal food-group coverage; Order meal preparation tasks; Scale recipe quantities. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Help me map meal food-group coverage.
Help me order meal preparation tasks.

prompts: Help me map meal food-group coverage.
Help me order meal preparation tasks.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Plate Mosaic: Meal Plans workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.description: Map meal food-group coverage. Reproducible inputs: {"meals":[{"name":"Lunch","groups":["vegetables","grains","protein"]},{"name":"Snack","groups":["fruit"]}]}
positive.prompt: Help me map meal food-group coverage with these supplied values: {"meals":[{"name":"Lunch","groups":["vegetables","grains","protein"]},{"name":"Snack","groups":["fruit"]}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses meal_balance_board_group_coverage with the supplied inputs. Returns {"meals":[{"name":"Lunch","groups":["vegetables","grains","protein"]},{"name":"Snack","groups":["fruit"]}],"day_groups":["vegetables","grains","protein","fruit"],"not_recorded":["dairy or alternative"],"note":"A group inventory; not every group is required at every meal."}. Shows the actual meal-grid result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Order meal preparation tasks. Reproducible inputs: {"tasks":[{"name":"Chop vegetables","minutes":10,"batch":"Dinner"},{"name":"Cook grains","minutes":20,"batch":"Lunch and dinner"}]}
positive.prompt: Help me order meal preparation tasks with these supplied values: {"tasks":[{"name":"Chop vegetables","minutes":10,"batch":"Dinner"},{"name":"Cook grains","minutes":20,"batch":"Lunch and dinner"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses meal_balance_board_prep_sequence with the supplied inputs. Returns {"tasks":[{"name":"Chop vegetables","minutes":10,"batch":"Dinner","step":1,"start_minute":0,"finish_minute":10},{"name":"Cook grains","minutes":20,"batch":"Lunch and dinner","step":2,"start_minute":10,"finish_minute":30}],"sequential_minutes":30,"note":"Sequential task timing only; cooking and storage safety follow the actual recipe and labels."}. Shows the actual steps result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.prompt: Help me scale recipe quantities with these supplied values: {"original_servings":4,"desired_servings":6,"ingredients":[{"name":"Rice","amount":200,"unit":"g"},{"name":"Water","amount":400,"unit":"mL"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses meal_balance_board_portion_scaling with the supplied inputs. Returns {"factor":1.5,"ingredients":[{"name":"Rice","amount":200,"unit":"g","scaled_amount":300},{"name":"Water","amount":400,"unit":"mL","scaled_amount":600}],"note":"Arithmetic scaling; cooking times may require separate adjustment."}. Shows the actual recipe result. Does not fabricate external data.
